blocks.text: You can create custom dashboards by using preconfigured dashboard templates from the Template Gallery page. These templates include preconfigured widgets designed to address common use cases that you can customize as necessary. You can also clone an existing template to create a new dashboard.
To create a dashboard using a template:

blocks.item: In the Agentic SecOps Platform Admin Portal, click Explore.
In the left-side navigation, click Dashboards.
See image.
Select the Template Gallery tab.
On the Template Gallery page, you can:
Edit an existing template.
Click the template to edit.
The dashboard preview page appears.
Click the Edit Dashboard icon.
See image.
Add or edit the dashboard widgets as necessary.
Click Save As.
The Save as a New Dashboard window appears.
In the Save as a New Dashboard window:
Name: Edit the dashboard's name.
Description: (Optional) Edit the existing description, or enter a new description.
Viewers: Select the users who can view the dashboard.
Public: Select to grant view access to all users in the account.
Specific Users: Select specific users that can view the dashboard.
To keep the dashboard private, leave the Viewers drop-down menu blank.
Editors: Select the users who can edit the dashboard.
Public: Select to grant edit access to all users in the account.
Specific Users: Select specific users that can edit the dashboard. The edit access overrides the view access.
To keep the dashboard private, leave the Editors drop-down menu blank.
Pin to Apps: (Optional) Select the application that you want to pin the dashboard to. This allows you to find the dashboard under My Dashboards in the app.
Tags: Enter a tag name, or select from existing tags. You can add one or more tags to a dashboard to categorize it.
See image.
Click Save.
The modified dashboard appears on the My Dashboards tab.
Duplicate an existing template.
On the Template Gallery page, hover over a template and click the Duplicate Dashboard icon. You can customize the duplicated template as necessary.
See image.
